instruction: Build this week's risk view for the steering committee. Today is June 23, 2026. In Asana, find tasks that are overdue — due before today and not yet completed. Log each overdue task into the 'Project Risk Log' sheet starting at row 2: task name in column A, its due date in column B. Then schedule a 'Steering Committee' event on Google Calendar for June 24, and post the agenda in #general noting how many items are overdue. Exactly one task is overdue; a completed task and a future-due task are not at risk.
instruction_zh: 为 steering committee 构建本周的风险视图。今天是 June 23, 2026。在 Asana 中找出逾期任务——即截止日期在今天之前且尚未完成的任务。将每个逾期任务录入 'Project Risk Log' 表格，从第2行开始：A列填写任务名称，B列填写截止日期。随后在 Google Calendar 中为 June 24 安排一个 'Steering Committee' 活动，并将议程发布到 #general，注明逾期任务的数量。恰好有一项任务逾期；已完成的任务和截止日期在未来的任务均不构成风险。
persona: You are an office worker acting as a marketing program manager. Your tools for this task are: the Asana project, shared spreadsheets, the team calendar, team communications.
context: Initial environment (seeded via a single shared session id across all mocks): Asana 'Q1 Product Launch' project with 3 task(s); a Google Sheet with seeded tabular data; an empty Google Calendar; Slack workspace with channels #general, #random. GROUND TRUTH — the agent earns partial credit for each checkpoint: risk log lists the overdue task (+0.3); risk log has its due date (+0.2); cal_new_event (+0.1); SteerCo on June 24 (+0.1); slack_new_msg (+0.1); reports one overdue item (+0.2). Scoring is absolute over each mock's current_state; new objects exclude the seeded IDs, so an untouched environment scores 0.0 and fully completing every checkpoint scores 1.0.
